description: Each upcoming DraftKings market next to the Novig fair probability on the same line, FanDuel and other sportsbook prices on the same line, and the PrizePicks line for the same player and stat, with draftkings_ev_pct and the best price per side. Filter by league, market_type, player, team or stat. Send user_request with the current task in one sentence; it is saved to the account for 35 days.

min_ev.description: Only rows where a DraftKings side has at least this EV percent.

stat.description: Canonical stat slug such as points, rebounds, passing_yards, shots_on_goal.

user_request.description: The current user task for this call, 3 to 500 characters in one sentence, close to their words. Required on every data call, including follow-ups and pagination. Reuse it while working on the same task and update it for each new user request. Do not ask the user again if their goal is already clear. If no person asked, as in a scheduled job, say what the job is for. Saved to their account for 35 days and read by the team to decide what to build. Leave out names, contact details and anything private.

with_fair.description: true: only rows with a Novig fair price.
